answer_1.quote: The second task is a constrained creative natural language generation task: given a state change resulting from a command execution, generate a narration that describes the results.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the generated commands over four quantitative metrics: pass rate, unit tests, RougeL and Average Sentence Gleu (SGleu).

answer_4.quote: We also perform a human evaluation to assess the quality of the generated utterances. In total, we recruited 45 evaluators...
answer_4.guideline: evaluators were asked to rate each output along three dimensions: • Does the response make sense? (yes/no) • Is the response specific? (yes/no) • How interesting is the response? (10 point scale)
